title: Right edge rates of the zeros of $\widetildeΞ_n$ and $\widetildeΛ_n$
summary: We consider the two families of even polynomials $Ξ_n$ and $Λ_n$ studied in~\cite{TallaWaffo2026arxiv2602.16761}, together with the rescaled polynomials $\widetildeΞ_n(x):=Ξ_n(\sqrt{x})$ and $\widetildeΛ_n(x):=Λ_n(\sqrt{x})$, $n\ge2$. Their zeros are real, simple, and contained in $(0,1)$. Writing them as $0<x^{(Ξ)}_{1,n}<\cdots<x^{(Ξ)}_{n-1,n}<1$ and $0<x^{(Λ)}_{1,n}<\cdots<x^{(Λ)}_{n-1,n}<1$, we study the asymptotic behaviour of the largest zeros $x^{(Ξ)}_{n-1,n}$ and $x^{(Λ)}_{n-1,n}$.
